description:
Manage your IDEs the easy way.

Open any of your projects in any of the IDEs with one click.
Toolbox App 3.7.1 Bugfix Update
- Fixed an issue where Remote Development plugins were blocked with IDE Services.
What's New in Toolbox App 3.7
Reliable IDE installation and updates on macOS 27
The Toolbox App now installs and updates IDEs reliably on macOS 27.
JVM memory optimizations by default
The Toolbox App now enables JVM memory optimizations by default. The configuration tunes memory management, code-cache behavior, and garbage collection without requiring setup. TBX-18852
Fixed Windows Smart App Control compatibility
The Toolbox App now launches when Windows Smart App Control is enabled. TBX-18777
Patch updates on macOS
Some JetBrains IDEs create runtime files inside their macOS app bundles. During a patch update, the Toolbox App verifies the updated bundle's code signature, removes files that are not sealed by the new build, and downloads a clean copy if verification still fails. TBX-18856
Session-expiration improvement
If you've seen an unexpected session-expired notification, please try the Toolbox App 3.7 update and report the issue if it persists.
See the full list of release notes here.
